subject: Request: PO / Invoicing Format + Net14 exception and discount packaging
messages:
From: Dana Mills <dana.mills@helixhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements + Net14 ask for enterprise onboarding

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the product looks promising. Procurement has a few blocking items before we can issue a PO:
- We need invoices to include the Helix supplier code (HHLX-33421) and PO number on the remittance line.
- Our standard net terms are Net14 for trial/early-adopter engagements; will Redwood accept Net14 for the first 3 monthly invoices?
- We have to split invoices: one invoice for software subscription, a separate invoice for professional services (on the same monthly cadence).

I've attached our PO template and vendor onboarding form. If you can confirm the format and whether your billing system can emit two separate invoice line-items/files per month, procurement will prepare a conditional PO.

Also, one procurement note on pricing: we were quoted a 20% introductory discount — procurement wants that on the SOW/invoice lines rather than as a credit after billing. Can your team produce the SOW with the discount baked in?

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can align legal and finance.

Thanks,
Dana Mills
Sr. Procurement Manager
Helix Health
Attachment: Helix_PO_Template_v3.pdf (PDF, 62KB)
Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Dana Mills <dana.mills@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + Net14 ask for enterprise onboarding

Hi Dana — great to hear from you and glad the demo was helpful. I pulled in Ben (billing) and Lauren (sales lead) to confirm specifics. Quick answers up front:
- We can include the supplier code and PO number on every invoice; our billing template supports a "remittance identifier" field. Please confirm the exact text for the remittance line and we'll mirror it.
- Net14 is shorter than our standard Net30 for hosted accounts, but we can make a temporary Net14 exception for the first 3 invoices for the HLX pilot. Finance will need this approved in writing as part of the SOW or a credit memo process.
- We can emit two separate invoices per month (one for subscription, one for services). Our system will produce distinct invoice numbers but can reference the same PO.

Regarding the 20% introductory discount: we can include that on the SOW as a line-item discount against the subscription MRC. For services, pricing will reflect the discounted rate if stated in the SOW. We prefer discount on the SOW so it flows directly to invoices and to your procurement system.

Action items I propose:
1) Ben, can you verify the remittance formatting we need to match (supplier code placement + PO field)?
2) Dana, if you can return the PO template with the exact supplier code string and confirm the account to bill, we'll draft the SOW with the discount included and the Net14 clause for the first three invoices.
3) Lauren, we'll present the final SOW/terms for signature and attach to DocuSign.

I attached a proposed pricing schedule reflecting the introductory discount so your team can preview how it will appear on invoices.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Attachment: Proposed_Pricing_Schedule.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dana Mills <dana.mills@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + Net14 ask for enterprise onboarding

Dana / Soojin — quick notes from billing:
- Format: we can place "Supplier Code: HHLX-33421" on the invoice header right under the billing address. PO number will populate the remittance reference and the electronic payment EFT file.
- Net terms: Finance will allow Net14 for the first three invoices. However, our collections team requires a signed SOW that includes a Net14 clause and an acknowledgement from Helix that subsequent invoices revert to Net30 unless otherwise approved. We'll add a brief clause to that effect.
- Split invoicing: we'll generate invoices with separate invoice numbers and separate GL mappings (subscription vs. services). If Helix requires separate PDFs to be sent to different AP inboxes, specify both emails and we'll route accordingly.

One more item: our AR workflow prefers discounts applied as a discount line per invoice rather than as post-billing credits (easier for reporting). Since you asked for the 20% to appear on the invoice, we'll include a discount line item on both subscription and services invoices per the SOW.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Dana Mills <dana.mills@helixhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + Net14 ask for enterprise onboarding

Thanks, Soojin and Ben — this resolves most questions. A couple of follow-ups before procurement issues the conditional PO:
1) Please use the exact remittance text: "Supplier Code: HHLX-33421 | Bill To: Helix Health - AP Dept" on the invoice header.
2) We do want the 20% introductory discount visible on the SOW and each invoice line.
3) Send invoices to ap-invoices@helixhealth.com and cc accounts-payable@helixhealth.com.

I'm uploading our PO to DocuSign and will send a conditional PO number once the SOW includes the Net14-first3 clause and the remittance line. Expect a DocuSign link from procurement shortly.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting the pilot live.

Dana Mills
Sr. Procurement Manager, Helix Health
